rule: If the array's noise index N (mean H(beta) over the noise sites) is above N_max, the gauge state is withheld unless the reading is tared against same-run healthy references (Stage T). Nothing is fitted.
provenance: DEV-NOISE-01 (doors/DEV_NOISE_01_OUTCOME.md): N on the Salas purified neutrophil arrays used for the EPIC reference (GSE110554; GSE167998 re-deposits the same 6 physical arrays) ranges 0.1223-0.1489; N_max is the top of that range. Replaces the fitted noise correction of DEV-NOISE-02 (A = a + b f_neu + c N), which was set after looking at the data.
